n, b = map(int, input().split())

a = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCount = [0] * (n + 1)
oddCount = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    a[i] = int(input())

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1]

differences = []

for j in range(2, n):
    diff = abs(a[j] - a[j + 1])
    if evenCount[j] == oddCount[j]:
        differences.append(diff)

differences.sort()

totalCuts = 0
for diff in differences:
    if b >= diff:
        b -= diff
        totalCuts += 1
    else:
        break

print(totalCuts)
